scheduler.doc:name: Produtos para Salesforce a cada hora

raise-error.description: O parâmetro date deve usar yyyyMMdd ou yyyyMMdd:yyyyMMdd.
A execução manual da sincronização de produtos está desabilitada.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "FAILED", message: error.description, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId default correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: error.description, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId default correlationId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "FAILED", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate default null, page: vars.runState.page default 0, requestNext: vars.runState.next default null, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "UNKNOWN") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), description: error.description default null, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId default correlationId }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var suppliedDate = vars.requestedDate default "" var suppliedParts = (suppliedDate as String) splitBy ":" var today = if (isEmpty(suppliedDate as String)) (now() >> p("productsSfSync.scheduler.timeZone")) as Date else (suppliedParts[-1]) as Date {format: "yyyyMMdd"} var yesterday = today - |P1D| var lastUpdate = if (sizeOf(suppliedParts) == 2) suppliedParts[0] ++ ":" ++ suppliedParts[1] else (yesterday as String {format: "yyyyMMdd"}) ++ ":" ++ (today as String {format: "yyyyMMdd"}) --- { lastUpdate: lastUpdate, page: 0, next: null, hasMore: true, totalRecords: 0, seenCursors: [] }

logger.doc:name: Log início
logger.message: #[write({event: "products-sf-sync-started", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId}, "application/json", {indent: false}) as String]

raise-error.description: O limite de segurança foi atingido e o ARTSOFT ainda devolveu next.

logger.doc:name: Log conclusão
logger.message: #[write({event: "products-sf-sync-completed", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate, pages: vars.runState.page, records: vars.runState.totalRecords, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId}, "application/json", {indent: false}) as String]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "COMPLETED", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate, pages: vars.runState.page, records: vars.runState.totalRecords, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId }

logger.doc:name: Log falha
logger.message: #[write({event: "products-sf-sync-failed", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate default null, page: (vars.runState.page default 0) + 1, requestNext: vars.runState.next default null, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "UNKNOWN") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), statusCode: error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default null, description: error.description default null, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId default correlationId}, "application/json", {indent: false}) as String]

logger.doc:name: Log página consultada
logger.message: #[write({event: "products-sf-page-queried", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate, page: vars.runState.page + 1, requestNext: vars.requestedNext, returnedNext: vars.artsoftPage.next, records: sizeOf(vars.artsoftPage.data), correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId}, "application/json", {indent: false}) as String]

when.expression: #[vars.artsoftPage.next != null and (vars.artsoftPage.next == vars.requestedNext or (vars.runState.seenCursors contains vars.artsoftPage.next))]

raise-error.description: O ARTSOFT devolveu um cursor next repetido.

sdc:insert-objects.doc:name: Enviar página ao Salesforce Data Cloud

logger.doc:name: Log página aceita
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- write({event: "products-sf-page-accepted", page: vars.runState.page + 1, records: sizeOf(vars.artsoftPage.data), statusCode: attributes.statusCode default null, response: payload, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

logger.doc:name: Log página vazia
logger.message: #[write({event: "products-sf-page-empty", lastUpdate: vars.runState.lastUpdate, records: 0, correlationId: vars.syncCorrelationId}, "application/json", {indent: false}) as String]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.runState ++ { page: vars.runState.page + 1, next: vars.artsoftPage.next, hasMore: vars.artsoftPage.next != null, totalRecords: vars.runState.totalRecords + sizeOf(vars.artsoftPage.data), seenCursors: if (vars.artsoftPage.next == null) vars.runState.seenCursors else vars.runState.seenCursors ++ [vars.artsoftPage.next] }
